name: Pro card chasing

card.summary: Training and competing in amateur physique contests to earn a professional card, which drives people to build and refine their physique.

quick.overview:
A pro card is the qualification that lets an athlete compete professionally in a federation such as the IFBB Pro League. Chasing one means entering amateur contests with the goal of winning a card.

The goal pushes competitors to build muscle and conditioning to a high standard.
quick.how: Athletes win a regional contest in their weight class, may be invited to national championships, and class or overall winners can receive a card depending on the federation. In the US, the NPC awards cards at events such as Nationals, the North American Championships, the Universe and the USA Championships.[1]
quick.risks: Preparation is demanding; no sourced risk detail was gathered for this entry.

lead: Pro card chasing is the pursuit of a professional card in bodybuilding and physique sports. The IFBB Pro League is described as the elite federation, and athletes must earn a card to become IFBB Pros.[1]
The route runs through amateur contests: regional wins, national championships and, in some federations, a card for every weight-class winner.[1]

angle.text: The competitive goal organises training and diet around building a stage-ready physique.

paras: Athletes start by winning a regional show in their weight class, then may be invited to nationals; winners may compete for an overall title that can carry a card.[1]
